opus.problem: Clue 1 gives the word away. 'A pillar of this' completes the very well known phrase 'pillar of salt', so it is not medium hard. Keep the story but drop the phrase, for example by describing what happened to Lot's wife without naming the pillar.

Clue 2 gives the word away. 'This of the earth' completes the common saying 'salt of the earth', so it is not medium hard. Keep the Sermon on the Mount teaching but use a different detail, such as losing its savor and being thrown out and trampled.
